lines: I am still finding my place here. You made sure there was a here to find it in.
I had no station, no trade, just a door to hide behind. You kept that door standing.
I do not have much here yet, but you helped keep what I might become part of.
The village still has room for me because people like you fought for it.
I had nowhere important to stand, so I watched. You stood somewhere important.
You protected more than houses. You protected chances.
I saw a future here look less certain, then you pushed back.
Maybe I'll find work tomorrow because there is still a village tomorrow.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
